items.label: Target filters
items.desc: Choose players and NPCs independently, with collision visibility checks and a distance limit.

items.label: Target points
items.desc: Select head, chest, pelvis or nearest target points.

items.label: FOV controls
items.desc: Adjust the pixel radius and display a targeting circle.

items.label: Smoothing and prediction
items.desc: Tune frame-rate-independent smoothing and velocity prediction.

items.label: Target lock and indicators
items.desc: Bounded target locking with an optional marker and line.

items.label: Activation key and mode
items.desc: Configure the activation key and mode. Aiming requires a living local player, supported camera, game focus and a closed menu.

items.label: Players, NPCs, vehicles and self
items.desc: Separate enable, range and appearance settings for each profile.

items.label: Boxes and appearance
items.desc: Full or corner boxes, outlines, fill and stroke/fill gradients.

items.label: Names, distance and snaplines
items.desc: Player names from MTA, model IDs for unnamed entities and configurable label positions and colors.

items.label: Skeletons and health
items.desc: Ped skeletons, health bars and independent HP text.

items.label: Weapon labels
items.desc: Append current weapon names to player and NPC ESP or radar labels.

items.label: Team classification
items.desc: Player classification follows MTA team identity. NPC relationships remain unknown.

items.label: Interactive CJ preview
items.desc: Rotate and zoom the sample model, drag labels and health bars, and open appearance settings from preview elements. The preview does not enable gameplay ESP.

items.label: Radar
items.desc: Shared radar with configurable appearance options.

items.label: San Andreas terrain map
items.desc: Displays the local player and streamed player blips and names. Unstreamed players are not tracked.

items.label: Map appearance and activation
items.desc: Adjust map size, dot size, opacity and activation key/mode. F6 is the default map toggle.

items.label: Waypoint and coordinates
items.desc: Select a map waypoint or enter coordinates, with optional ground snapping. Requires the supported client, focus and an on-foot local player.

items.label: Back and saved position
items.desc: Return to the last successful origin or save and return to one session position.

items.label: Coordinate and waypoint tools
items.desc: Copy your current coordinates into the fields and set or clear a menu waypoint.

items.label: Script manager
items.desc: Run and stop text .lua scripts, including bundled Player HUD and Events and timers examples.

items.label: Lua editor and console
items.desc: Edit, save and run scripts, and review errors in the Lua console.

items.label: API docs and overlays
items.desc: Browse the supported API and build custom UI or render overlays.

items.label: Snapshots, events and timers
items.desc: Access supported player, NPC and vehicle snapshots, local player values, local custom events, timers and Vector3 helpers. This is Scooby Lua 5.4, not the native MTA resource runtime.

items.label: Profiles and hotkeys
items.desc: Save configurations and customize menu and feature bindings. Insert or F1 opens the menu.

items.label: Themes and backgrounds
items.desc: Customize themes and use PNG or GIF backgrounds.

items.label: Interface scale
items.desc: Auto Scale adapts the menu and overlays to the render surface; manual scale settings remain available.

items.label: Language and overlays
items.desc: Choose interface language and overlay settings.

items.label: Pickup ESP
items.desc: The tab is present but disabled; pickup enumeration is not supplied by the current adapter.

items.label: Spawner operations
items.desc: Spawner operations remain unavailable.

items.label: Vehicle teleport and region changes
items.desc: Vehicle teleport and changing interior or dimension are not implemented.

items.label: Spectator telemetry
items.desc: The current adapter does not provide spectator telemetry.

items.label: Full MTA resources
items.desc: Native resources, meta.xml, resource exports, remote/server events, engine object creation and compiled Lua are not supported by Scooby's script runtime.
